scope: Theorem 7.2 of the manuscript “Quantitative Superexponential Bounds for van der Waerden Numbers” (preprints/Quantitative-Superexponential-Bounds-for-van-der-Waerden-Numbers-September-23-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 160 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 042acea33a57b58d), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 20. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: For every pair of integers r ≥ 256 and k ≥ 3, Wr(k) > exp ( (log r)2 64 log 2 ) .
